rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial term for the animal.

example.english: I kept a rabbit when I was young.
example.traditional: 我細個嗰陣養過一隻兔仔。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 joeng5 gwo3 jat1 zek3 tou3 zai2

rows.note: Use this only when the rabbit is specifically white, rather than as the general animal term.

example.english: There is a white rabbit at the zoo.
example.jyutping: dung6 mat6 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 zek3 baak6 tou3

rows.note: Use this specifically for meat from a rabbit.

example.english: The rabbit meat at this restaurant is very tender.
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 tou3 juk6 hou2 nyun6
